title: ScheduleVersionResponse
description: A [Schedule Version](/api-reference/schedule-management/models/schedule-version) representing one submission attempt. Each re-submission creates a new version.

acceptance_level.description: Highest acceptance level reached: empty string, `ack`, `ano`, `par`, or `cnf`.
acceptance_level.title: Acceptance Level

created_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this version was created.
created_ts.title: Created Ts

is_active.description: Whether this is the active version: the latest version the TSO has accepted, the one it currently treats as binding. Rejected or not-yet-answered versions are not active, and a later rejected version never replaces an accepted earlier one.
is_active.title: Is Active

last_modified_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the most recent status change.
last_modified_ts.title: Last Modified Ts

message_id.description: TSO document identification assigned to this version's message.
message_id.title: Message Id

nrr_received.description: Whether a Non-Repudiation of Receipt (NRR) delivery confirmation has been received from the TSO.
nrr_received.title: Nrr Received

spec.description: Full submission specification including market routing and series references.

status.description: Processing status. `created` before submission, then the verbatim market status: `submitted`, `ack_positive`, `ack_negative`, `ack_partial`, `icnf`, `dacnf`, `cnf`, `cnf_partial`, or `fcnf`.
status.title: Status

transmission_report_id.description: Mako365/AS4 transmission report identifier for delivery tracking.
transmission_report_id.title: Transmission Report Id

version.description: Sequential version number (1-based). Increments with each re-submission.
version.title: Version

warnings.description: TSO warnings from the ACK response, if any.
warnings.title: Warnings

in_area.description: EIC Y code of the receiving control area.
in_area.title: In Area

in_party.description: EIC X code of the receiving party (balance responsible party).
in_party.title: In Party

out_area.description: EIC Y code of the sending control area.
out_area.title: Out Area

out_party.description: EIC X code of the sending party (balance responsible party).
out_party.title: Out Party

time_series_uid.description: Time series identifier used in the ESS/CIM document.
time_series_uid.title: Time Series Uid

ts_version.description: Per-series version number (`SendersTimeSeriesVersion` in ESS) — the version in which this series last changed.
ts_version.title: Ts Version

uid.description: Unique identifier for this series record.
uid.title: Uid

ScheduleVersionSpec.description: The full specification that was submitted with a schedule version, including market routing and all series.

receiver_id.description: EIC X code (DE) or EAN-13 (NL) identifying the TSO receiver.
receiver_id.title: Receiver Id

sender_id.description: EIC X code identifying the schedule sender.
sender_id.title: Sender Id

series.description: The individual time series included in this version.
series.title: Series

tso.description: TSO identifier the schedule was sent to.
tso.title: Tso

ScheduleVersionSpec.title: ScheduleVersionSpec

WarningItem.description: A TSO warning returned in an ACK or CNF response (e.g. B45, A54).

code.description: Warning reason code from the TSO response.
code.title: Code

WarningItem.title: WarningItem
